integrity: The covariance is reconstructed from exact permutation probabilities. The determinant and inverse follow from the continuant recurrence and are checked by exact multiplication. The partial-correlation identity is applied only after positive definiteness is proved.
scientific_limitations: Only linear least-squares partial correlations are classified; nonlinear conditional correlations are not.
The permutation is uniform and only ordinary adjacent descents are treated.
The tridiagonal inverse method is classical, leaving a residual risk of an older unnoticed specialization.
title: Fibonacci precision law for random-permutation descent indicators
